chunks: Whoever looks after the family of a pilgrim with goodness in their absence shall have a reward like his reward, as though they themselves were touching the stones.

key_terms.الْأَحْجَارَ: the sacred stones associated with the rites
key_terms.بِخَيْرٍ: with goodness, kindness, and proper care
key_terms.خَلَفَ: to take care of or act on behalf of someone in their absence
key_terms.كَأَجْرِهِ: a reward equal to his reward

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for caring for the family of someone who has gone for hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great merit of supporting a pilgrim’s family during the pilgrim’s absence. It presents such care as a deed of immense spiritual reward, equal to the pilgrim’s reward, highlighting the ethical and communal dimensions of hajj.
